\newglossaryentry{input}{name={input},description={is the starting information supplied to a computation. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:count}; see also \glslink{output}{\glsentryname{output}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{output}{name={output},description={is the resulting information we read from it. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:count}; see also \glslink{input}{\glsentryname{input}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{step}{name={step},description={is one specified action in a procedure. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:count}; see also \glslink{rule}{\glsentryname{rule}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{computation}{name={computation},description={means carrying out specified rules on represented information to obtain a result. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:count}; see also \glslink{rule}{\glsentryname{rule}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{rule}{name={rule},description={is an explicit instruction specifying an allowed operation. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:rule}; see also \glslink{computation}{\glsentryname{computation}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{program}{name={program},description={is instructions written in a form a computer can carry out. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:code}; see also \glslink{function}{\glsentryname{function}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{Python}{name={Python},description={is the programming language used for these examples. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:code}; see also \glslink{program}{\glsentryname{program}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{function}{name={function},description={is a named, reusable rule in this program. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:code}; see also \glslink{program}{\glsentryname{program}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{information}{name={information},description={here means what a chosen description tells us about the possibilities relevant to a task. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:representation}; see also \glslink{representation}{\glsentryname{representation}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{representation}{name={representation},description={is a chosen way to express information through distinguishable forms. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:representation}; see also \glslink{information}{\glsentryname{information}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{physical-medium}{name={physical medium},description={is the material carrier of a representation. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:representation}; see also \glslink{representation}{\glsentryname{representation}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{atom}{name={atom},description={is a small constituent of matter, such as a carbon atom. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{bond}{\glsentryname{bond}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{bond}{name={bond},description={is a chemical connection that holds atoms together. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{atom}{\glsentryname{atom}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{molecule}{name={molecule},description={is a group of atoms joined by chemical bonds. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{dna}{\glsentryname{dna}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{dna}{name={DNA},description={is deoxyribonucleic acid, a molecule that carries genetic information in living organisms. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{molecule}{\glsentryname{molecule}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{strand}{name={strand},description={is one connected chain in DNA. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{sequence}{\glsentryname{sequence}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{sequence}{name={sequence},description={is an ordered list; a DNA sequence records the order of those letter-labeled parts. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:dna}; see also \glslink{strand}{\glsentryname{strand}}.}}
\newglossaryentry{dna-computing}{name={DNA computing},description={means using designed DNA-based physical processes to carry out computational tasks. First taught in Section~\ref{sec:bridge}; see also \glslink{dna}{\glsentryname{dna}}.}}
